chapters.label: The final
chapters.text: Sweden, 1958, the World Cup final. Brazil, in blue, lead Sweden two goals to one. Now a high ball drops into the box, where seventeen-year-old Pelé is waiting.

chapters.label: Chest control
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Pelé cushions the ball on his chest, and it drops softly, right in front of him.

chapters.label: Flick and volley
chapters.text: A defender rushes in. Pelé flicks the ball over his head, spins round him, and volleys it in before it lands!

chapters.label: Soft touch
chapters.text: Cushion the ball like Pelé and it stays close. A soft first touch buys you time and space.
